steps.en: Install the binary wheel; FFmpeg is bundled inside it
steps.zh: 装二进制 wheel，FFmpeg 已打包在里面

steps.en: Open the media file and ask for the frames of one stream
steps.zh: 打开媒体文件，要某一路流的帧

steps.en: Demuxes the container and decodes each packet in-process with libavcodec
steps.zh: 在进程内拆封装，用 libavcodec 逐个包解码

steps.en: Ask each decoded frame for an array in the pixel format you want
steps.zh: 让每一帧按你要的像素格式变成数组

steps.en: Converts the pixels with libswscale and hands back a NumPy array
steps.zh: 用 libswscale 转像素格式，交回 NumPy 数组

value.en: FFmpeg's codec coverage, one decoded frame at a time, inside your Python process — no subprocess, no pipe parsing
value.zh: 在 Python 进程里一帧一帧拿到 FFmpeg 能解的任何格式，不起子进程、不解析管道

sources: https://github.com/PyAV-Org/PyAV README (Installation: pip install av, wheels for Linux/macOS/Windows with FFmpeg bundled; requires Python 3.12+)
